brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack (a panel to hold tools)
requirements.evidence: Six full bases in a 3-wide x 2-storey flat panel (piece:-1,0,0 through piece:1,0,1), capped with capOpenFaces and bolted with lockJoints (jointBolt:1#-1,0#0, jointBolt:1#0,0#0); check_build ok, meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Four hex-acc-keyhole accessories at both ends of both levels: accessory:0#-1,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#0, accessory:1#-1,0#1, accessory:1#1,0#0, so the panel lifts onto wall screws and drops into place.

Six hex-acc-hook hook plates (each carries two hooks, 12 hooks total) on the front face: accessory:0#-1,0#3, accessory:0#0,0#2, accessory:0#1,0#2, accessory:1#-1,0#2, accessory:1#0,0#2, accessory:1#1,0#2. Staged with a cable coil and a gaffer-tape roll hanging on two upper hooks (prop:4, prop:5, visible from the rear view az=180); the configurator's prop library only lets coils/tape/goggles hang on hooks, so hand-tool props themselves could not be hung as props, but the physical hooks are in place for real small hand tools.

finish.summary: Built a wall-hung tool rack: a 3-wide x 2-storey hex panel with four keyhole hangers at the ends of both levels for lift-and-drop wall mounting, and six hook plates (12 hooks) across the front for small hand tools. Open faces capped, joints bolted, check_build clean with meshClash clear. A cable coil and gaffer-tape roll hang on two upper hooks to show the hooks in use (the prop system only hangs those items; lower hooks are staged empty since a tape roll there would dip through the bench in the model only).

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Wall-hung tool rack with keyhole hangers and hooks — I'll scout the current build and the parts that can form a back panel, hangers, and tool hooks.
